{{Top|leg}}
'''Fiber-alloy''' was a material that could be used to make [[Knife/Legends|knife]] blades. Knives made from fiber-alloy were considered to be sharper than metal, resistant to rusting, non-conductive, and hard to detect with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
